docs.text: About Us Our God is able Portal Schedule a Visit Search this site Since 2016 A Brief History was founded in 2016 by Shaibu Sidikat Ruth to serve children and families in Ageva. The school offers Creche, Nursery, Primary 1–4 and Primary 6 . Its stated focus is to build strong academic foundations, good character and readiness for each child's next stage. Families are encouraged to visit the school and ask the office to confirm current facilities, class arrangements and availability. Our Mission Building an effective and efficient future leader: raising confident, brilliant and well-mannered children through strong academics and morals. Our Vision To be the most trusted school in Okene, where every graduate shines in secondary school and beyond.
